verdict.rationale: gstack docs explicitly define each supported coding agent (Claude, Codex, Factory, Kiro, OpenCode, Slate, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, GBrain) as a typed TypeScript config object, and adding a new host requires only one file with 'zero code changes to the generator, setup, or tooling' — indicating the same skill collection can be installed with per-agent config across many harnesses. Community discussion (gstack-comm-3) confirms the install model works but questions how it scales to divergent per-repo flows, and hands-on chatter centers mostly on Claude Code rather than confirming smooth operation across all listed agents. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of successful installs in Codex/Cursor specifically, and detail on what 'per-harness instructions' concretely differ beyond the config object.
